# DiffSMol

This directory contains DiffSMol, which MADDIE's HitIdentifier uses for
ligand-based, shape-conditioned molecule generation. It is the work of its
authors and is included here so that a MADDIE campaign can be reproduced from a
single checkout. Paths to model checkpoints in
`config/DiffSMol_pocket0.5.yml` are placeholders and must be set before use.

If you use this component, please cite:

> Z. Chen, B. Peng, T. Zhai, D. Adu-Ampratwum, X. Ning. *Generating 3D small
> binding molecules using shape-conditioned diffusion models with guidance.*
> Nature Machine Intelligence 7(5):758–770, 2025.
